FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN VITE_API_URL=/api pnpm run build
WORKDIR /app/server
RUN npm ci
RUN npx prisma generate
RUN node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const s=fs.readFileSync("prisma/seed.ts","utf8"); fs.writeFileSync("categories.mjs", s.slice(s.indexOf("const DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES"),s.indexOf("async function main"))+"\nexport default DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES;\n");'
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import fs from "node:fs";' 'import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";' 'import { prisma } from "./src/prisma.ts";' 'import categories from "./categories.mjs";' 'import auth from "./src/routes/auth.ts";' 'import applications from "./src/routes/applications.ts";' 'import documents from "./src/routes/documents.ts";' 'import clients from "./src/routes/clients.ts";' 'import notifications from "./src/routes/notifications.ts";' 'import admin from "./src/routes/admin.ts";' 'if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET || !process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD) throw new Error("Missing required runtime environment");' 'fs.mkdirSync("/app/.data/uploads", {recursive:true});' 'await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {' '  if (!(await tx.admin.findUnique({where:{username:"sindiswa-cell"}}))) {' '    if (await tx.admin.count()) throw new Error("Existing instance requires reviewed owner provisioning");' '    await tx.admin.create({data:{username:"sindiswa-cell",fullName:"System Administrator",email:"sindiswa-cell@owner.invalid",passwordHash:await bcrypt.hash(process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD,12),active:true,mustChangePassword:false}});' '  }' '  await tx.systemSetting.upsert({where:{id:1},update:{},create:{id:1,allowRegistration:true,emailNotifications:true,maxUploadMb:5,maintenanceMode:false,privacyNotice:"iHOPED processes personal information in line with POPIA. Data is used solely to assess housing assistance applications and will not be shared without lawful basis."}});' '  for (const category of categories) await tx.documentCategory.upsert({where:{id:category.id},update:{},create:{...category,enabled:true}});' '});' 'const app=express();' 'app.use(express.json({limit:"2mb"}));' 'app.use("/uploads",express.static("/app/.data/uploads"));' 'app.get("/api/health",(_req,res)=>res.json({ok:true,service:"ihoped-api"}));' 'app.use("/api/documents",(_req,res,next)=>{' '  const json=res.json.bind(res);' '  res.json=body=>{' '    const relative=doc=>{if(doc && typeof doc.previewUrl==="string"){const url=new URL(doc.previewUrl);if(url.pathname.startsWith("/uploads/")) doc.previewUrl=url.pathname+url.search+url.hash;}return doc;};' '    if(body?.document) relative(body.document);' '    if(Array.isArray(body?.documents)) body.documents.forEach(relative);' '    return json(body);' '  };' '  next();' '});' 'app.use("/api/auth",auth);' 'app.use("/api/applications",applications);' 'app.use("/api/documents",documents);' 'app.use("/api/clients",clients);' 'app.use("/api/notifications",notifications);' 'app.use("/api/admin",admin);' 'app.use("/api",(_req,res)=>res.status(404).json({error:"Not found"}));' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist"));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res)=>res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'app.use((err,req,res,next)=>{console.error(err);res.status(500).json({error:err.message||"Server error"});});' 'const server=app.listen(3000,"0.0.0.0");' 'for(const signal of ["SIGTERM","SIGINT"]) process.on(signal,()=>server.close(async()=>{await prisma.$disconnect();process.exit(0);}));' > deploy.mjs
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite HOME=/tmp
COPY --from=build /app/dist /app/dist
COPY --from=build /app/server /app/server
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data && rm -rf /app/server/uploads && ln -s /app/.data/uploads /app/server/uploads && chown -R 10001:10001 /app/.data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 3000
WORKDIR /app/server
CMD ["node","--import","tsx","deploy.mjs"]
